column1: # Export receipt, written by the export tool after it wrote the other files of this extract.
# Each line names a file and gives its records, counted the way data_quality.json counts the
# rows of that file. Where a field is named, field_sum is the sum of that field's values as they
# are written in the file, over all of its records; otherwise field and field_sum are empty.
# A file whose lines here agree with it arrived whole.
